meta.name: agent-team
meta.description: 统一管理多智能体角色的团队协作框架，支持智能体动态组合、灵活协作和扩展新角色。智能体本质上是"角色定义"，可以根据任务需求灵活组建团队，实现从会议决策到系统构建的完整能力。智能体角色明确分工：有干活的、有指挥的、有挑毛病的，能实时看到沟通过程，共享数据库记忆，确保上下文一致。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组建多智能体团队协作完成任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要管理多个智能体角色并协调它们协作完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate multi-agent teams to collaborate on tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage multiple AI agents and coordinate their collaboration

howto.what: 装上后,面对复杂任务,Claude 会组建一个虚拟智能体团队——有指挥、执行、评审等角色,它们实时讨论、分工协作,共享同一份记忆,最后产出统一的会议记录、方案或代码。
howto.when: 当任务需要多个智能体协同完成,或需要管理特定场景的智能体组合时触发;也常用于技术架构决策、OPC 系统构建、产品定价等预设场景。

say.text: 请用技术决策团队评估微服务架构方案
say.note: Claude 会展示多角色讨论和决策过程

say.text: 请用OPC团队构建AI短视频领域的系统
say.note: Claude 会依次执行战略、产品设计和技术实现

say.text: 用自定义团队,包含产品经理、技术架构师、评审员,评估产品方案
say.note: Claude 按指定角色组建团队并协作

howto.what_en: After installation, for complex tasks, Claude will form a virtual agent team—with commanding, executing, and reviewing roles—that discusses in real time, collaborates, shares the same memory, and finally outputs a unified meeting record, plan, or code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when multiple agents need to collaborate, or when managing agent combinations for a scenario. Also used for preset scenarios like technical architecture decisions, OPC system building, and product pricing.

say_en.text: Evaluate the microservices architecture with the technical decision team.
say_en.note: Claude forms the team and shows discussion and decisions.

say_en.text: Build an OPC system for the AI short-video domain.
say_en.note: Claude follows strategy, product design, and implementation.

say_en.text: Custom team: PM, tech architect, reviewer to assess this product plan.
say_en.note: Claude uses the specified roles for collaboration.
